core_objective.title: AI-Driven Interactive Electrochemical Reaction Workflow System
core_objective.statement: Build an AI-driven research workflow system within CatGO that enables CatBot to autonomously plan, generate, and orchestrate multi-step VASP AIMD + slow-growth + constant-potential calculations for studying cation effects on C-N coupling reactions at Cu-water interfaces.
success_criteria: User describes research goal in natural language, CatBot generates structured computation plan
CatBot enumerates all chemically valid C-N coupling paths from given C and N species
CatBot builds slab+water+cation models with correct cation placement (near-surface vs bulk-water)
CatBot generates complete DAG workflow for each coupling path: opt -> AIMD equil -> slow-growth AIMD (constant-potential)
User confirms plan, CatBot generates VASP input files and submits to HPC
Results automatically collected and analyzed (barrier extraction, cation effect comparison)
non_goals: Full autonomous execution without human confirmation
Real-time AIMD simulation within CatGO (all DFT runs on HPC)
Supporting non-VASP DFT codes for v1

use_case.title: Cation Effects on C-N Coupling at Cu-Water Interface
use_case.system: Cu(111) slab + explicit water layer + alkali cation
use_case.coupling_definition: Formation of C-N bond between any C-species and any N-species adsorbed on surface

cation_conditions.label: no_cation
cation_conditions.description: Baseline: Cu slab + water, no cation

cation_conditions.label: Li_near
cation_conditions.description: Li+ near Cu-water interface, bonding with adsorbate

cation_conditions.label: Li_far
cation_conditions.description: Li+ in bulk water layer, far from adsorbate

cation_conditions.label: K_near
cation_conditions.description: K+ near Cu-water interface, bonding with adsorbate

cation_conditions.label: K_far
cation_conditions.description: K+ in bulk water layer, far from adsorbate

computational_pipeline.name: Model Building
computational_pipeline.description: Cu slab + water + optional cation + adsorbate pair

computational_pipeline.name: Slow-Growth AIMD
computational_pipeline.description: Constrained MD varying C-N distance, LBLUEOUT=.TRUE., with constant-potential

computational_pipeline.name: Analysis
computational_pipeline.description: Parse REPORT, extract barriers, compare across cation conditions

requirement_alignment.interaction_mode: C - AI plans + generates inputs + user confirms -> submit HPC -> auto-collect results

acceptance_criteria.criterion: CatBot generates C-N coupling network from user-specified species lists
CatBot builds Cu slab + water + cation model through tool calls
Slow-growth AIMD workflow node generates correct VASP inputs (INCAR + ICONST)
Constant-potential overlay (TPOT/CP-VASP) applied to slow-growth node
CatBot plans multi-step workflow: opt -> AIMD equil -> slow-growth for coupling path
AI research planner decomposes high-level goal into computation tasks
Batch workflow creation from computation matrix
Cation placement supports near-surface and bulk-water strategies

technical: Must integrate with existing DAG workflow engine
Must use existing VASP input generation backend (already supports slow-growth + TPOT + CP-VASP)
Must work with existing HPC SSH connection system
CatBot tool loop limited to 15 rounds — tools must be batch-capable
scientific: Not all 40 C-N pairs are chemically meaningful — AI must filter
ICONST atom indices must survive through all structure transformations
Cation placement must avoid unphysical short contacts
Constant-potential needs Fermi level and target electrode potential
operational: User must confirm each workflow before HPC submission
